Name: Greenhouse Upgrades
Author: CosmicKillsSouls
Description:
[size=3]The upgrades are purchased at robin, and additional greenhouses can be purchased if the config is set to true and the player has the initial greenhouse.[/size]


[size=4] Please note:[/size]

[size=2]This mod functions by replacing the greenhouse once it is built and transferring everything over to the default modded greenhouse (12x12) If you are using a larger greenhouse please remove everything from your greenhouse to prevent it from being lost.[/size]
